title: US court documents detail a Commerce Department pressure campaign on Intel to acquire a 10% equity stake in 2025, warning rejection would carry "consequences" (Noah Shachtman/Wired)
summary: Noah Shachtman / Wired: US court documents detail a Commerce Department pressure campaign on Intel to acquire a 10% equity stake in 2025, warning rejection would carry “consequences” — Donald Trump's dealings with Intel reveal yet another a government-led pressure campaign involving a private company, court documents show.
